name: Salvation For The Dead
overview: Scripture reveals that salvation extends beyond physical life, as Jesus declares that the dead will hear His voice and live, affirming His authority over both the living and the dead. Christ's resurrection and lordship provide hope that belief in Him grants eternal life even after death. While some passages, like Matthew 12:32, emphasize the seriousness of rejecting the Holy Spirit with no forgiveness in this life or the next, others, such as Philippians 1:23, express the believer's confident hope of being with Christ after departing this world. Together, these verses affirm the centrality of Christ's power to grant life and salvation beyond death.
